title: REQ · App tracks round loading/error and renders HeaderOverlay in the header slot
summary: App passes world title, round, loading and error to HeaderOverlay via GameLayout header.
description: Context: App calls getCurrentRound and swallows errors. Desired behavior: track loading and error message state, render <HeaderOverlay worldTitle round loading error /> as the header prop. Expected result: loaded, loading and error states visible in header. Why: explain API failures instead of silent fallback.
acceptance_criteria: Given the round resolves, then the header shows round id and status.
Given the request is pending, then the header shows Loading round….
Given the request rejects with Error('boom'), then the header alert shows 'Round unavailable: boom'.

in_scope: App.tsx round state and header wiring

technical_constraints: Use getCurrentRound from api/client; world title from world in runtime/content
